  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue

  agent_failure_modes:

      description: If the Planner incorrectly deduces that the "second pick" refers to the second AL pick (Eric Munson) based on flawed logic, and instructs the WebSurfer to confirm this, the WebSurfer will only validate the wrong hypothesis.

    - type: loop_issue
      description: If the Planner oscillates between interpreting the task as "second overall" and "second AL pick" without converging on a definition, it will send conflicting instructions to the WebSurfer.
      severity: 0.7
